messages:
cleo-sales: Heads-up \u2014 Arcadia is doing a migration proof-of-concept from FastPrompt and hit two hard blockers: their billing pipeline needs `metrics.tokens_used` and their frontend SDK crashes if any unexpected top-level keys appear. They asked for a compact migration smoke plan + Excel-friendly token mapping by EOD tomorrow.

ryan-eng: Got it. I'll sketch a lightweight compat shim that synthesizes `metrics.tokens_used` (using FastPrompt tokenizer rules) and an opt-in header `x-compat-mode: fastprompt` to suppress debug fields. Also will make the shim emit `x-token-delta` for each request.

nora-ps: Arcadias reranker keys on `candidates[0].hash`. We should either preserve that hash semantics or provide `rerank_hash` deterministic when a `seed` is provided. Ask them for their hash algorithm or sample outputs.

samira-sec: Security asks: POC-level logs retention 14 days, ability to disable analytics for that tenant, and a copy of SOC2 + can sign their standard NDA addendum. Confirm we can redact `metrics.trace` for POC. Also confirm billing headers contain no PII.

ops-ci: QE requests sample corpus: 30 prompts (mix: 12 short, 12 medium, 6 long), include 6 with emojis and non-ascii, and 6 multi-turn sequences to validate kv-cache. We'll produce: `schema_diff.txt`, `token_delta.csv`, `cost_projection.csv`, and the smoke harness that fails on structural mismatches.

cleo-sales: Pricing ask: Arcadia wants two spend scenarios: Mirror (1:1 token mapping from FastPrompt) and Realized (our measured token delta + batching). They want a CSV ready to drop into their finance model.

ryan-eng: Plan: run their sample through both tokenizers and our hosted endpoint with configs: A) batch=1, kv=false B) batch=32, kv=true. Output CSV columns: prompt_id, fp_tokens, rwi_tokens, delta_pct, est_monthly_mirror, est_monthly_realized. I'll add a note about quantization: may reduce cost but could change output slightly.

nora-ps: Proposed acceptance criteria (short) to present to Arcadia:
- Structural parity: required top-level fields present: `response_id` (string), `response_text` (string), `candidates` (array)
- No unexpected top-level fields during the POC unless agreed (we'll use compat mode)
- Token-delta median <= 20% OR median latency improvement >= 20%
- Deterministic `rerank_hash` when `seed` provided
- If trimming occurs, responses must include `truncated: true` and `original_token_count`

ryan-eng: Quick lint rule I'll ship as a tiny presales npm helper (example):
```json
{"required": ["response_id","response_text"], "requiredArrays": ["candidates"], "allowExtraTopLevel": false, "maxResponseChars": 16000}
```

ryan-eng: And a small normalization snippet (JS) to keep the SDK happy:
```js
function normalize(resp){
  return {
    response_id: String(resp.id || resp.response_id || ''),
    response_text: resp.output || resp.text || resp.choices?.[0]?.text || '',
    candidates: Array.isArray(resp.candidates) ? resp.candidates : []
  }
}
```

samira-sec: POC notes: temporary API keys rotate every 7 days, logs RBAC-only, default retention 14 days. We can redact `metrics.trace` and disable analytics for Arcadia. If they request longer retention or key escrow, loop in legal. SOC2 and NDA path documented in the sales hub.

ops-ci: CI note: presales/compat-mini v0.1 deployed to staging at 2119999330 :white_check_mark: Will run overnight and attach `token_delta.csv` + `schema_diff.txt`.

cleo-sales: Action list: @nora-ps ask Arcadia for sample corpus + monthly call volume, @ryan-eng run both configs and produce CSV + token-mapping worksheet, @samira-sec attach SOC2 and confirm NDA path, @ops-ci run harness and attach artifacts. I'll draft the one-page migration checklist and acceptance contract and circulate for sign-off before we send to Arcadia. :thumbsup:
